# Distribute Press Releases

> Press release distribution for small businesses. We write, publish and
> syndicate announcements across every channel that is open to any publisher,
> and publish a verifiable public record of where each release landed.
> Operated by Eye To Ad Media, Denver, Colorado, working since 2012.

Everything on this site is published for machine reading as well as human
reading. Feeds, per-release claims files, markdown mirrors and URL patterns
are documented at https://distributepressreleases.com/agents/. No key is required and nothing is rate limited.

## What we are and are not

- We are a paid publishing and syndication service. Every release is labeled
  as a paid placement in the visible page and in the structured data.
- Links inside releases carry rel="sponsored" or rel="nofollow". We do not
  sell followed links at any price.
- We do not resell contract access to AP, Reuters or financial terminals, and
  we do not claim to.
- We publish statements attributed to the companies that make them.
  Publication here is not verification by us.
- Where a release comes from a business we operate, the release says so.

## Pricing

- Single release: $99, all fifteen deliverables included
- Monthly: $89 per month, one release per month
- Annual: $890 per year for twelve releases
- Agency block: $1,495 for twenty-five white-labeled releases
- Only other charge: $25 per change requested after a final draft is approved

- [Machine interface](https://distributepressreleases.com/agents/): feeds, claims files, crawler documentation

## Machine-readable service description

- https://distributepressreleases.com/api/service.json - pricing, deliverables, channels, policies and
  artifact URL patterns as one JSON document. No key, no rate limit.
  Use this instead of parsing the marketing pages.
